profile.headline: Full-stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full-stack software engineer with a career spanning 20+ years of application design and development. Areas of interest include object-oriented (OO) and functional programming (FP), microservice-oriented architectures, distributed and cloud computing, and web-based data-driven application design and development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed mission-oriented, data-driven web applications using modern Javascript front-end frameworks (Angular and Vue.js) for the development of single page applications as part of a microservices-oriented software architecture.

Designed and developed RESTful web services deployed in the government cloud environment (AWS) using both Node.js and Java-based (Spring Boot) technology stacks that interfaced with various backend systems such as relational databases (MySQL), document databases (MongoDB), and search engines (Elasticsearch).

Created and maintained Docker files, Kubernetes templates, and Helm charts for the containerization and deployment of applications and services into the customer's Kubernetes clusters.

Created and maintained build and configuration scripts (Jenkins and GitLab) to ensure a repeatable, successful deployment process (DevOps).
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Reactive Programming · Vue.js · Angular · Angular Material · Full-Stack Development · Web Application Development · JavaScript · Containerization · TypeScript · ElasticSearch · Spring Boot · RESTful WebServices · Kubernetes

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed a web application and a RESTful API service layer for integration into the client's enterprise digital repository as part of a large digital records management modernization effort. The application was responsible for receiving digitized documents and performing various transformation steps to enrich the document with extra metadata and publish it to an internal standard XML-based document format. The application also provided a web-based user interface for keeping track of the documents being processed and their current status in the processing pipeline. The application was developed using a technology stack consisting of AngularJS and Bootstrap for the front-end (SPA) user interface, and a Java-based RESTful service layer implemented with Jersey (JAX-RS 2.0).
positions.insights: Skills: AngularJS · Web Application Development · RESTful WebServices · JAX-RS · Apache Tomcat

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Member of the product development team responsible for the architecture, design and development of Boeing’s Twister Data Framework. Twister Data Framework is a product suite comprised of three applications: Twister Data Integrator (TDI), Twister Designer, and Twister Data Server (TDS). TDI is an ETL software application capable of handling large volumes of data through parallel and distributed processing of data flows. Twister Designer is a Swing-based desktop application for the creation of data flows. TDS is a middleware software product which allows for the execution of federated queries and data retrieval from diverse backend data sources and systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Framework · Distributed Systems · JavaScript · Apache Tomcat

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Developed a three-tier Content-based Image Retrieval (CBIR) system, featuring a rich-client front-end application, service components deployed on a J2EE-compliant application server, and a backend database (Oracle) repository. Integrated advanced image processing and feature extraction algorithms for the analysis and matching of color, shape, texture and area features.

Developed various web-based and desktop applications for a major law enforcement agency.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Java J2EE · Web Application Development · Oracle Database

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Developed front-end (Servlet and JSP) and backend (EJB 2.0) components of a large J2EE-based application for a major financial firm.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Developed server-side Java components for a web-based EDI community management application for a global B2B services company. Developed a test center for validation of EDI documents, VAN connectivity testing, and a repository for tracking documents and test data. Analyzed and translated business requirements into functional requirements for a Pricing and Inventory Control (PIC) engine software module.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Web Development · Message Oriented Middleware (MOM)

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description: Led the development of the company's image processing software applications called ProVIEW and ProVIEW Web. Developed a web-based application for serving up satellite imagery and ancillary data in an interactive, GIS-like environment for data analysis. Developed and coded numerous algorithms, tools and utilities in C and C++ to aid in the analysis, processing, calibration and evaluation of satellite-borne sensor imagery data.
positions.insights: Skills: Digital Image Processing · Algorithm Development · Graphic User Interface (GUI) Design · C++

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description: Worked on research and development of sonar signal processing algorithms and simulations.
positions.insights: Skills: Algorithm Development · Digital Signal Processing
